title: Decisions API is in public beta
summary: OpenAI has launched the Decisions API in public beta, enabling developers to build AI agents capable of multi-step reasoning and complex decision-making workflows. This API extends beyond traditional chat completions to support structured decision chains with tool use.
problem_solved: Enables developers to create AI applications requiring complex, multi-step decision-making capabilities without building custom orchestration layers from scratch.
why_valuable: Simplifies the development of sophisticated AI agents by providing built-in support for structured decision chains, reducing complexity and development time for production AI applications.
